title: Just Like Me: The Role of Opinions and Personal Experiences in The Perception of Explanations in Subjective Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews (N=20) to evaluate how participants' pre-existing beliefs and personal experiences influence their perception of AI-generated versus human-authored explanations, specifically measuring how alignment with their own opinions increases perceived convincingness and trustworthiness.

Prompting an LLM (GPT-3) with internet-sourced scenarios of "subtle sexism" to generate explanations arguing whether the situation is sexist or not, and having human participants evaluate the relevance, convincingness, and trustworthiness of these explanations.
